name: Walker
author: brodgar
description: Example addon: the gated write tier, one deliberate verb at a time. It declares the 'actions' permission, so it is disabled by default and enabling it asks for your consent; each ':walker <sub>' fires exactly one gated verb -- hafen.act()'s MapView, menu, flower and item actions, plus the per-subsystem writes on the movement speed, the action bar, the action menu, the kin roster and the radial menu's own petal selection.
